title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy
description:
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy collects Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Justice for All, and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Trials and Tribulations. Across 14 episodes, players investigate crime scenes, collect evidence, question witnesses and defend clients in court.

Courtroom sequences revolve around identifying contradictions between testimony and evidence, while investigation sections focus on examining locations and speaking with characters. The current Nintendo Switch version also includes added accessibility and gallery features such as Episode Selection, Story Mode, Auto-play, a Music Player, an Art gallery and a Scene Creator.

nintendoNotes: Nintendo lists the trilogy as a single-player Nintendo Switch release with Simplified Chinese support. The collection contains the first three Phoenix Wright games and 14 episodes. A later update expanded convenience and gallery features. No verified direct Full Wrap was found, so 3D texture fields are blank.
tagline: Investigate crime scenes, collect evidence and expose contradictions in 14 episodes spanning Phoenix Wright’s original courtroom trilogy.
fitFor: Players who enjoy mysteries, visual novels, courtroom drama and logic-based contradiction solving.
Players who want the first three Phoenix Wright games in one modern package.
Players who prefer character-driven stories and puzzle-like reasoning over action combat.
notFitFor: Players who want fast real-time action or combat-focused gameplay.
Players who dislike reading large amounts of dialogue and examining testimony carefully.
Players looking for multiplayer; the trilogy is a single-player experience.

gameplayPillars.title: Investigate Crime Scenes
gameplayPillars.description: Talk to witnesses, examine locations and gather evidence before trial so every object and statement can become part of the case.

gameplayPillars.title: Cross-Examine Testimony
gameplayPillars.description: Press witnesses for more detail, compare statements with evidence and present contradictions at the right moment.

gameplayPillars.title: Character-Driven Mysteries
gameplayPillars.description: Recurring allies, rivals, prosecutors and clients connect individual cases into a larger trilogy-spanning story.

worldSummary: The trilogy takes place in a stylized legal world where defense attorney Phoenix Wright investigates crime scenes and then defends clients in high-pressure trials. Police stations, offices, homes and unusual locations feed evidence into courtroom confrontations where testimony, logic and character motives drive the central puzzles.

storyChapters.title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney
storyChapters.body: Phoenix begins his career as a defense attorney, learning to investigate cases and challenge testimony under the guidance of Mia Fey.

storyChapters.title: Justice for All
storyChapters.body: New cases and the introduction of the Psyche-Lock mechanic deepen the investigation side while Phoenix faces increasingly difficult courtroom dilemmas.

storyChapters.title: Trials and Tribulations
storyChapters.body: The third game connects past and present cases, developing Phoenix, Mia and their rivals while bringing major trilogy story threads together.

features: Contains all 14 episodes from Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, Justice for All and Trials and Tribulations.
Investigation sections revolve around examining crime scenes, collecting evidence and questioning characters.
Courtroom sections require comparing testimony with evidence to expose contradictions and advance each case.
The collection supports Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese text alongside multiple other languages.
The November 2025 title update added Episode Selection, Story Mode and Auto-play to make replaying or focusing on narrative easier.
The same free update added a Gallery with a Music Player, Art viewer and Scene Creator.

verdictSummary:
Score note: 8.1/10 is a direct normalization of the current 81/100 Metacritic aggregate for the Nintendo listing; it is not a separately invented store rating.

The trilogy remains one of the strongest entry points into Ace Attorney because its three-game structure combines memorable mysteries, recurring characters and courtroom logic in one package, with later quality-of-life additions reducing friction for new players.
verdictPros: Three full Ace Attorney games and 14 episodes in one release.
Excellent character writing and satisfying contradiction-based courtroom puzzles.
Modern convenience and gallery features improve accessibility.
verdictCons: Large amount of reading may not suit action-focused players.
Some investigation sequences can require very specific interactions.
